questions.prompt: Which contact blocks the reverse coil when the forward contactor is energized?
questions.answer: The normally closed F contact in the reverse rung
options: The normally closed F contact in the reverse rung
The normally open F holding contact
The normally closed R contact in the forward rung
questions.explanation: Energizing F opens its normally closed interlock in series with the R coil. This prevents the reverse coil from energizing at the same time.
